alt.en: Two gray database cylinders at the left send dashed orange arcs with packets up onto a gray neural network card at the back right, and a dotted gray line runs from the card to a violet bar chart standing in the center.
alt.zh: 左侧两个灰色数据库各有一条带数据包的橙色虚线弧线，汇到右后方的灰色神经网络卡片上；一条灰色点线从卡片连到中央的紫色柱状图。

caption.en: Illustration: a federated training setup in which two data sites send model updates to a central model, and the results of different configurations are compared on a chart. It does not depict NIST's testbed, dataset or any measured result, and it does not show that the privacy settings work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：联邦训练的示意，两个数据站点把模型更新发送到中央模型，不同配置的结果在图表上比较。图中不代表 NIST 的测试平台、数据集或任何实测结果，也不表明其隐私设置如描述那样有效。
